title: Decentralized Ranking Aggregation via Gossip: Convergence and Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2602.22847v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The concept of ranking aggregation plays a central role in preference analysis, and numerous algorithms for calculating median rankings, often originating in social choice theory, have been documented in the literature, offering theoretical guarantees in a centralized setting, \textit{i.e.}, when all the ranking data to be aggregated can be brought together in a single computing unit. For many technologies (\textit{e.g.} peer-to-peer networks, IoT, multi-agent systems), extending the ability to calculate consensus rankings with guarantees of convergence and resilience to potential contamination in a decentralized setting, when preference data is initially distributed across a communicating network, remains a major methodological challenge. translated_title: 基于Gossip算法的去中心化排名聚合：收敛性与鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 排名聚合的概念在偏好分析中扮演着核心角色。文献中已记录了大量用于计算中位数排名的算法，这些算法通常源于社会选择理论，并在集中式设置下（即所有待聚合的排名数据能够汇集到单一计算单元时）提供理论保证。对于许多技术（例如点对点网络、物联网、多智能体系统）而言，在去中心化环境下——即偏好数据最初分布在通信网络中时——扩展计算共识排名的能力，同时保证收敛性以及对潜在污染数据的鲁棒性，仍然是一个重大的方法论挑战。事实上，近年来关于去中心化计算的文献主要集中于使用gossip算法来计算或优化诸如算术平均值之类的统计量。本文的目的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对偏好数据分布在通信网络中的去中心化场景，研究如何利用gossip算法实现排名聚合，并提供收敛性保证与对污染数据的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper studies decentralized ranking aggregation via gossip algorithms in settings where preference data is distributed across a communication network, providing convergence guarantees and robustness to contamination.
